Method of Attack: Ransomware attack encrypting servers and workstations, stealing data, disrupting networks and business operations
Impacted Systems: Sinclair Broadcast Group's corporate Active Directory domain
TV stations including KABB, WCHS, WPGH, KOKH, WBSF, WCWN, WPFO, WTAT, WRGB
Attack Vector: Compromise via corporate Active Directory domain leading to shutdown of Active Directory services
Indicators of Compromise: disruption of local advertisements and broadcast operations
use of Gmail accounts and PowerPoint for newscasts
replacement of local NFL games with national sports programming
